summary: Third attention backend evaluated and REJECTED: PlagueKind's H3 SLA Attention (block-sparse). Installed on the G:/ComfyUi bench, node registered and kernel module imported (no kernel launched), then removed at Fabio's call - its own engine is Triton, which is engine-owned and cannot enter the curated pip set, and we ship a product that has to work everywhere. Measured on disk: the shipped engine has NO triton and NO sageattention (torch 2.13.0+cu130, ComfyUI 0.34.0) while the bench has triton-windows 3.7.0 and sage 2.2.0 - so bench results are not evidence about a user's machine. Its Triton-free path needs comfy-kitchen>=0.2.32 (sol_attn, PR #16072) and core v0.34.0 hard-pins 0.2.31, but that path silently drops multi-span protect_audio, reference_protection and stabilize_motion - so the free half is the one weakest on audio, which is where H3 breaks first. Written up in docs/models/h3/performance.md alongside the SolAttn/Sage rejection; comfy kitchen attention stays the shipped answer.
